# NovaPanel v1.6.146

- Remove fleet configuration templates and canary rollout. Keep remote inbound creation as a fresh protocol draft for selected servers.
- Let each target's inbound name be edited, with a server/protocol default such as `la-http`. Use the same name for preview and creation, retain manual names while changing protocol or selected targets, and reject blank or duplicate names before remote writes.
- Continue using each target server's own TLS configuration, domain, and local users when creating an inbound.
